title: TraitTrail mixed specimen test set
group_identity_note: Groups are source scan sessions or catalogue specimens, not a claim of independent biological specimens. The identities of scanner subjects across sessions are unverified.
purpose: Fixed exploratory input set, not labelled ground truth or an accuracy benchmark. Preserve this version and record model, settings and prompt with test results.
